title: pdfmux
description: PDF extraction that audits its own output — and certifies any other extractor's. Routes each page to the best of 7 backends (PyMuPDF, OpenDataLoader, RapidOCR, Docling, Surya, Marker, Mistral OCR) with optional BYOK LLM fallback (Claude/GPT-4o/Gemini/Ollama). Per-page confidence scoring catches blank pages, mojibake and broken column order, then re-extracts failures with a stronger backend. The verify_extraction tool audits ANY engine's output (Reducto, LlamaParse, Docling, your in-house parser) for pages it silently dropped, and verify-manifest checks a Cloud Ed25519-signed manifest offline with no account. Scores 0.903 on opendataloader-bench: #2 of all tools, #1 free. Returns Markdown, JSON, or LLM-optimized chunks.
